name: themisdb-community
description: ThemisDB COMMUNITY Edition - Specialized vcpkg dependencies (apt-installed libs excluded)
comments: - apt-installed (Stage 2a): boost, openssl, fmt, spdlog, nlohmann-json, curl, zstd, lz4, snappy, tbb, yaml-cpp, mimalloc, pugixml, grpc, protobuf
- vcpkg-installed (Stage 2b): rocksdb (custom patches), gtest, benchmark, simdjson, tl-expected, msgpack, libzip
- Rationale: apt packages are pre-compiled and available for all platforms (amd64, arm64, etc.)
vcpkg packages require custom version control or build flags
